chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād narrated from Ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:

I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying: “Whoever walks with a جنازة until he performs salat over it and then returns, there shall be for him one qīrāṭ. فإذا he walks with it until it is buried, there shall be for him two qīrāṭs, and the qīrāṭ is like Mount Uḥud.”

key_terms.جَبَلِ أُحُدٍ: Mount Uḥud, used here to indicate great magnitude
key_terms.جَنَازَةٍ: funeral bier or funeral procession of the deceased
key_terms.يُصَلِّيَ: to perform salat over the deceased

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for accompanying a funeral until the prayer or burial?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the great reward for accompanying a funeral. Attending the funeral prayer earns one qīrāṭ of reward, while remaining until burial earns two, showing the immense merit of honoring the deceased and fulfilling communal duty.
